blind.second_guess: ancient stone cylinder lock / cryptex pillar
blind.description: A squat cylindrical puzzle pillar or combination dial mechanism constructed from aged stone and tarnished bronze/brass. It consists of a shallow domed cap divided into radial segments, three stacked rotating drum sections carved with glyphs and eye-like symbols separated by brass/bronze spacer rings, and a slightly wider stepped circular base with matching carved markings. Surfaces are continuous, solid, and cleanly formed with weathered, mossy green-brown textures.
blind.from_above: A circular dome segmented into radial keystone-like tiles surrounding a central circular boss, resembling a stone wheel or turtle shell pattern.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 3.5 to 4 feet tall (roughly two-thirds the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and roughly 1.5 to 1.8 feet in diameter, noticeably broader than the figure's cylinder body.
